normalization: Training-column mean/std only;std floor1e-6; no normalization search
risk_objective: Equal-study mean absolute error between risk estimate and independently predicted absolute ATP error
selection: ceil(c*n) per study; unchanged seed2301 SHA tie convention
failure_event: historical frozen abs ATP error>250nM; operational diagnostic, no calibrated assay tolerance
hyperparameter_discrepancy: historical supersedes historical fixed5/defaultbandwidth with six-setting training-only grid; default still included; record uniform validation scores and first-grid tie selection
nested_protocol: Outer test O excluded. Risk validation V excluded from all risk-training residual models and their alpha tuning. Each risk-training residual study R excluded from its predictor fitting/tuning. Final risk uses five outer-training studies OOF residuals; risk validation trains on four-study pools; residual predictors have four or three studies respectively.
CORAL: Same covariance+I fixed historical adaptation. Predictor alpha selected by raw source-only grouped validation, inherited as in historical. Each residual query study supplies only its unlabelled image covariance; risk geometry recomputed for its target study. No target ATP/control ATP fitted.
fallback: Abort if fewer than3 residual pool studies, rather than in-sample residuals; not expected with six groups
negative: Training OOF mean-risk constant and1000 within-study permuted new risk scores; no biological CI
success: historical stricter descriptive target:>=10% macro selective gain versus support,>=4/6 group gains and no group>10% harm; decision distinguishes small or subgroup-inconsistent differences
resources: CPU1, per-study checkpoints,<=120s/fold,>=20GiBfree,stopGPU sensor>=60C or unexpected shutdown; no data/model/package download
